thread:
maria: Heads up — noticed a cluster of invoices where quotas look low but usage increased. Dashboards show a big drop in token counts for a handful of orgs starting ~1890119000. Anyone else seeing ingestion lag?
ajay: Yup saw alerts. Ingest pipeline spikes around that window, consumer lag ~20m. Might be the Kafka partition reshuffle.
kevin: Do we have a consistent repro for which events are late? request vs token events behave differently.
maria: Mostly token events (token_count events). Request/usage lines fine. So it skews token-based billing only.
tara: That will impact invoice line items. Product asked about a couple of early churn emails. We should be clear if this is metering undercount vs dashboard lag.
liz: Quick glance at the consumer logs: lots of rebalances + backpressure on /metering/stream-processor. Error = "ConsumerRecords timed out" then retries.
maria: Can someone run a SQL to surface late events? I suspect reorder + eventual write but we don't re-emit billing events after late-arrival.
kevin: Running a query now:
```sql
SELECT org_id, event_type, count(*) as cnt, max(received_at) - max(event_ts) as max_lag_seconds
FROM billing_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2025-10-01'
GROUP BY org_id, event_type;
```
kevin: Preliminary shows token_count events with lag up to 1800s for 12 orgs.
ajay: So ingestion recovered and we ingested them eventually? Or got dropped?
maria: We see them in raw store, but the downstream metering job that aggregates to invoice-lines skipped processing that window because it uses time-bucket idempotency that assumes monotonic offsets. Late events end up in a "stale" partition that get ignored.
kevin: That logic was added to avoid double-counting during replays, but it's overly strict.
tara: Customer impact = under-billed tokens => revenue delta. For short term do we backfill invoices or add a correcting credit?
liz: Ops note: we temporarily scaled the stream-processor to 0.5->1.5x and it caught up. No data loss.
maria: Action items: 1) fix aggregator to accept late arrivals up to configurable window; 2) add dashboard flag for "ingest_staleness" so finance can see when counts are tentative; 3) create an automated backfill job to regenerate invoice-lines when aggregator changes.
ajay: +1. For 1) I'd prefer we make the dedupe idempotency key include event_offset + bucket_id to safely replay. Right now it keys only on bucket_id.
kevin: Agree. Also add a metric `ingest_lag_seconds` per org and expose p95/p99. That'll help route alerts to platform vs infra.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-593 - metering ingestion lag affecting token counts. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-593
ops-bot: Added Pager duty: eng-platform oncall.
tara: For 2) dashboard UX: product wants a visible banner on quota pages: "counts may be delayed due to ingestion lag" with a link to raw vs finalized numbers. Can we show both?
maria: We can show "Provisional (near-realtime)" vs "Finalized (billing)". Provisional uses streaming aggregates; Finalized uses post-aggregation window after backfills.
kevin: Implementation detail: keep streaming aggregates in Redis with TTL and tag them `provisional:true`. Finalized rows live in billing_tables with `finalized:true`. Charts pick which series to plot.
liz: Need to be careful with cache TTLs in console — currently the UI caches totals for 5m which masks recoveries. Lower TTL to 30s for the provisional number.
ajay: For backfill, we should make it tenant-scoped and incremental. Massive global backfill will risk another overload.
maria: Finance asked for a list of affected invoices (last 7 days). Kevin / Liz can we dump a CSV with diffs?
kevin: Yes. I'll run a diff job: compare provisional vs finalized after applying late events. Output will include invoice_id, org_id, delta_tokens, delta_amount.
liz: Also add a control in Console > Billing > Corrections to approve automated credits. Product wants human-in-the-loop for >= $500 diffs.
tara: Sounds good. Timeline?
maria: P1 hotfix to aggregator idempotency tomorrow morning (+1 oncall). Dashboard banner and metric exposure by EOD. Backfill job spec by EOD as well.
ajay: I'll spike an aggregator test harness to simulate rebalances and late events.
kevin: I'll own the CSV and backfill safe-runner.
liz: I'll change console TTLs and add provisional/finalized toggles.
maria: Communication — I'll send a short summary to finance and CS once we have affected invoice list. @tara can you loop them in?
tara: Yep, will follow up.
maria: Also a note for future: consider moving token accounting as an append-only ledger with watermarking instead of time-window drops. Helps audit.
ajay: Agreed. Add as RFC for eng-platform backlog.
kevin: One more quick check — we must ensure that promo credits application happens after finalization, otherwise credits might be misapplied. Add step to backfill to re-run credit assignment.
liz: noted.
sre-bot: INC-2025-593 state updated -> investigating.
ops-bot: Pager duty assigned to ajay.
maria: Thanks all. Short sync in 30 for action owners. :thumbsup:
